explanation.observation: The black segments mark the lowest observed mean within each group. Lowest-mean counts on this page: Both changes 5, Product order 1. A lowest mean alone is not proof of a clear win.
explanation.interpretation: These changes can improve the implementation, but the effect depends on shape and algorithm. Compare each variant with its own plain version. The fixed tile is 1024/1024/512; there is no Native XLA or full-tile Cubic baseline here. Product reordering alone does not prove that the TPU overlaps vector work and matrix multiplication.
